tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur ye shes myur 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru lo kī shwa ra ya/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du skal ldan gyi slob ma smin par byed pa'i rim pa la thog mar sngon gtor nas bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsnyen pa bcas song rjes/ mdun bskyed kyi gnas su me tog gi tshom bu lha dgu so so'i gnas su bkod nas mchod pa bskor bshams byas zin pa dang*/ me tog tshom bu'i gdan gyi steng du zhes pa nas gzhung du gsal ltar snyan gsan phab pa bcas song rjes/ u tiṣ+ṭha bar dang*/ de nas bum pa lhag gnas grub nas/ slob ma zung du ma gyur pa yol ba'i phyi rol du las bum gyi chus khrus byas la nang du 'ong gral du 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes man+ḍal bkye bsdu byas nas/ slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang la bzhag par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor du 'jug bar bya ba las sngon du 'gro ba slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i chos rnams gsan pa'i yon du man+ḍal phul/ zhes dkyil chog gzhung ltar man+ḍal phul/ de ltar man+ḍal 'bul ba sngon du song nas gsang chen bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i blos gsan 'tshal/ de'ang khyed rang rnams rnyed par dka' ba'i dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu ldan pa'i mi'i lus rten thob nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying po kar brgyud rin po che'i chos sgor zhugs shing theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i skal ba rnyed pa 'di lta bu ni sngon gyi skye ba mang por dge pa'i rtsa ba dpag tu med pa bsgrubs pa'i mthu las dus 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i skal ba phun sum tshogs pa thob par gyur pa yin pas/ de nyid chud mi gsan pa gal che ste/ gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gi rdo rje'i gsung las/ dal dang 'byor pa'i lus thob cing*// ston pa'i ston pa rnyed gyur te// skal ba phun sum tshogs pa la// su zhig 'bras bu med par byed// ces gsungs pa ltar yin/

des na snod kyi 'jig rten dang bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyang mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin yin la/ mi'i lus rten 'di ni rtag par grub pa med pas nges par 'chi ba kho na yin te/ bshes springs las/ sa dang lhun po rgya mtsho nyi ma bdun// 'bar bas bsreg pas lus can 'di dag kyang*// thal bar yang ni lus par mi 'gyur na// shin tu nyam chung mi lta smos ci 'tshal// zhes gsungs pa ltar mi rtag cing mi brtan pa'i 'khor ba las nges par 'byung pa'i blo bskyed cing las rgyu 'bras la blang dor byed pa gal che ba yin pa'ang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ gang zhig gser snod rin chen spras pa yis// ngan skyugs 'phyag par bgyid pa de bas ni// gang zhig mi ru skyes nas sdig pa dag /bgyid pa de ni ches rab blun pa lags// zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'khor ba las blo ldog cing dam pa'i chos zab mo la brtson dgos shing*/ des na chos nyan pa'i skabs su 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang bcas pa'i sgo nas nyan kyang snod dug can dang*/ kha sbub dang*/ zhabs rdol gyi nang du chu la sogs pa blug pa bzhin phyin ci log tu 'gyur pa yin pas dad pa gsum gyis kun nas bslang ste rang nyid la nad pa'i 'du shes/ bla ma la sman pa'i 'du shes/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes nye bar bzhag nas gsan 'tshal/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug bar bya// bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan// gzhan ni 'jig rten pha rol gnyer// slar yang dad dang ldan pa yis// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs te// blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug par bya// 'di yi 'bras bu don gnyer na// 'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na// 'di 'bras 'bad pa med par 'grub// zhes gsungs shing*/ de ltar 'jig rten 'di la ltos pa'i zhen 'dzin gyi blo spangs te bde chen lam gyi bsgrub bya mtha' dag sgrub par byed do snyam pa'i sems sngon du btang nas thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags kyi zag med bde chen la 'jug pa'i blos rdo rje slob dpon la dga' chen zhes bos te khyod ni bdag gi 'dren pa mchog tu bzung lags pa de'i phyir/

bdag thar pa'i grong khyer du 'jug par mdzad du gsol snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje nam mkha' mdzes pa yi// bdag gi ston pa dga' chen khyod// sems can kun gyi don brtson pa// mgon pos dam tshig bdag la stsol// sdom pa'i mchog kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang stsal du gsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// kun tu rtog pa spong pa yi// grong khyer nyams dgar gzhug par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum/ de nas zab mo gsang ba sngags kyi spyod tshul bshad par bya ste/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang cho ga zab mo 'di nyid la bsten te byang chub kyi <?>ོna shing dam par thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mngon du brnyes shing*/ bdud kyi sde thams cad yongs su bcom zhing pham par mdzad pa yin la de nyid kyi phyir na rigs kyi bu khyod rnams kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i phyir/ gsang chen bla med kyi cho ga zab mo la spyad par bya ba'i blo gros rnam par dag pa bskyed nas sems dga' spro dang bcas pas nyon cig /bu tshur theg pa chen po pa// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyi// gsang sngags tshul chen cho ga 'di// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams// de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa'i tshad ma brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pas// skyob pa sangs rgyas he ru kas// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang 'di yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang pos legs par nyon// brjed ngas blo la he ru ka sogs pa'i// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs// zhes gsungs pa ltar ma yengs par mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dmigs la 'di'i lad mo gyis/

phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*// yi dam lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// tha ma da lta thug gi bar// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis// lus ngag yid gsum sgo nas ni// sdig pa dpag med bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang la// khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags par bgyi// slan chad bdag ni mi bgyid do// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// 'phags pa nyan thos rang rgyal gyi// yan lag rnams kyang gzung bar bgyi// 'gro ba kun gyi dge ba la// bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*// bde gshegs chos sku la bzhugs kyang*// 'gro ba kun la phan don du// chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar ni// bdag ni rtag tu gsol ba 'debs// bde gshegs mdzad pa mthar phyin nas// mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed rnams la// bskal pa'i mtha' mar bzhugs par ni// bdag ni rtag tu gsol ba 'debs// bdag gi dge pa'i rtsa ba gang*// bgyis sam bgyid du stsal pa dang*// rjes su yi rang thams cad ni// 'gro ba kun gyis thob par shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i dag /bla mar bcas pa thams cad la// bdag gi lus 'di phul ba yis// theg pa dman la mi 'jug cing*// theg chen bla na med pa'i lam// zab cing rgya che bstan du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod/ skyabs su 'gro bar bya snyam pas rjes zlos/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog theg pa chen po'i chos zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun phyir mi ldog pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum/

sems bskyed pa'i lad mo gyis/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin dbang po// rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// sems can rnams gyi don slad du// byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed ltar// de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// bsod nams ye shes byang chub lam// thabs dang shes rab gom pas bgrod// de bzhin bdag gis lam bgrod do// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// thams cad mkhyen par sangs rgyas nas// mkha' mnyam sems can don mdzad ltar// de bzhin bdag gis don bgyi'o// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*// dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'da' ba dang*// kun kyang sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces lan gsum/ de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa nas gsungs pa dang mthun par 'jug pa yin la/ da ni bya ba dang spyod pa dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang mthun par 'jug par bya ste/ khyed rang gi spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar btod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ de lta bur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag pa'i mos pa mdzod la yi ge brgya pa thon cig /yi ge brgya pa brjod/ de nas rigs lnga spyi'i sdom pa dang dam tshig rnams 'dzin snyam pa'i sgo nas sdom bzung 'di'i lad mo mdzod/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims rnams// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// zang zing chos dang mi 'jigs byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba// pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog bsdus pa la// sdom pa thams cad yang dag ldan// kun nas so sor gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// 'gro kun mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum/

de nas khyed rang rnams skad cig gis rje btsun spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma na bgrang phreng*// g.yon gyi 'og ma na pad+ma 'dzin pa/ de'i thugs kar hrīḥdakar po las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyong bar mos la snying po 'di thon cig /oṃ maṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs brjod du bcug /de ltar bsgom pas lus ngag yid kyi sgrib pa dag pa dang*/ bar chad kyi bgegs bsrung ba dang*/ dngos grub thob bar bshad de/ pad+ma rgyal po'i rgyud las/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ rgya mtsho'i nang gi rin chen bzhin// lan gcig mos pas brjod pa na// sems can dmyal ba'i nad las thar// lan gnyis brjod pas yi dwags su// 'gro ba'i sgo yang 'gag par 'gyur// gsum brjod dud 'gro'i sgo yang 'gag /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga spyod kyang*// 'di dang ma bral gtsang mar gnas// bza' dang btung ba'i longs spyod kyang*// 'di nyid dran na nyes pa med// bdud kyi bar du gcod pa kun// sngags kyi rgyal po bgrang bas zhi// zhes gsungs pa rnams yid la bzhag nas deng nas gzung ste ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du gsang rigs gzungs sngags thams cad kyi rgyal po yi ge drug pa 'don pa la brtson par mdzod cig /dri zhim po'i shing sor bcu gnyis pa'i so shing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab la/ slob ma'i lag tu byin/ de nas dngos grub kyi mtshan ma brtag par bya ba'i phyir du khyed rang rnams zhal shar phyogs sam byang du blta bas thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du so shing bzung nas rtse mo cung zad 'cha' ba'i tshul dang bcas te oṃ badz+ra hā sa ha zhes brjod bzhin du 'dor bar zhu/ zhes so shing dor bcug /de ltar so shing dor ba'i dngos grub kyi mtshan ma bshad pa ni rtse mo nam mkhar bstan na mchog gi dngos grub/

shar du zhi ba'am grub pa chen po brgyad/ lhor rgyas pa'am 'jig rten pa'i/ nub tu dbang gi las sam chos smra ba/ byang du drag po'am phrin las sna tshogs pa/ thur du sa 'og gi dngos grub/ mtshams rnams su thun mong gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// dri bzang po'i chu dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang khyor gang blud cing*/ bam̐ yig las skyes pa'i dung chos kyi chus sdig sgrib thams cad bkrus pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba dharma sarba pa pam̐ ni tsā s+ya saṃ sho dha ya bi kalpa a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes khyor chu blud/ skud ba dmar po sum sgril la/ snying po rnams dang*/ oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta kri ta sogs bzlas nas mdud pa byas la/ hūm̐ yig las skyes pa'i srad bu dmar pos bar chad mi mthun pa'i tshogs rnams las srung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ bud+dha mai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarbān+tū swā hā/ zhes skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon/ bud med kyi g.yas la gdab bo// ku sha'i chun po gnyis/ hūm̐ dang dhīḥs byin gyis brlab la/ hūm̐ dang dhiḥyig las skyes pa'i ku sha'i chun po dag mi gtsang ba sel zhing dge ba'i ltas rmi lam du rtogs par byed pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa baṃ/ gcig g.yas su gtad/ oṃ badz+ra satwa zhes gcig g.yon du gtad la/ de ltar byin pa'i ku sha'i chun po gnyis sngas dang stan du gyis la/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa 'dir nyol cig /rmi lam gyi mtshan ma ji lta bu mthong ba de nangs par nga la smros shig /ces brjod/ de nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'dis// sems can sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du byas pa'i sdig pa gang*// de kun byang bar 'gyur ba ni// zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gro// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros brtan po g.yo med pa// de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyu// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas la// dbang thob 'bras bu skye bzhin par// de dag khyed rnams theg chen la// sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// lam 'dir khyed rnams 'gro ba la// rang byung skal ba chen po pa// 'jig rten kun gyi 'dren pa'i gnas// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur// zhes pa 'jig rten du 'khor los sgyur rgyal 'byon pa bas u dum wa ra'i me tog 'byung ba dkon cing*/

de las kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ba dkon/ sangs rgyas byon rung gsang sngags kyi chos ni 'gro ba kun gyi spyod yul du mi 'byon pa yin la/ rang cag gi ston pa 'di'i bstan pa la gsang sngags kyi chos rnams mi yul du byon pa'i mthus/ rdo rje slob ma khyed rnams kyang da lta dkyil 'khor 'di lta bur 'jug pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa ni bsod nams mang du bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir dga' ba rgya chen po gyis shig /bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ slob ma rang gnas su btang*/ de nas sta gon dang dngos bzhi nyin gnyis su byed na gtor bsngos dang rjes chog bya/ phyi nyin bdag bum mdun bskyed bcas 'don zhing dngos sta bsre/ yang dngos sta sbrel tshe bdag bum bskyar mi dgos shing ras bris bkram nas mdun bskyed bton mthar sta gon gyi lha bsre/ mchod bstod bzlas pa bdag 'jug tshogs dang bcas pa grub nas dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur skabs su/ slob ma rnams phyi rol du las bum chus khrus byas nas nang du 'ongs nas gral du bkod pa la/ bar chad bsal ba'i don du sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ las bum gyi chus bsangs ba'i gdong g.yogs dmar po gtad la/ de nas gdong g.yogs bcing ba ni/ grub chen la wa pas slob ma dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum gyi rim pas gdong g.yogs srab mo 'bring po mthug po gsum du bshad la/ de'i dgos ched ni dkyil 'khor ma bstan gyi bar du blta bar mi rung ba yin pas ras yugs dmar po kha tshar ma nyams pa re'i gdong g.yogs 'ching bar mos mdzod/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta kri ta badz+ra krodha h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsak+ṣu rban+dha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas bcings/ dkyil 'khor dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag rten med par mjal mi rung bas me tog gi phreng ba re byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba byin/

man+ḍal bkye bsdu byed/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad zung 'jug sku bzhi dang ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhu snyam pa'i sgo nas gsan 'tshal/ de'ang khyed rnams thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang zhu bar 'dod pa shin tu bzang*/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad theg pa che chung gnyis dang*/ sde snod gsum/ rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa la/ thugs rje chen po 'di rgyud sde bzhi'i rtsa ba zhag bdun tsam gyis dngos grub thob par byed pa yin te/ bya spyod kyi rgyud dang mthun par ā mo gha pā sha'i rgyud dang*/ thugs rje chen po'i gzungs dang rtog pa rnams yin/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang mthun pa ni/ pad+ma cod pan gyi rgyud dang*/ sgo drug pa rnams yin/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang mthun pa ni/ pha bla na med pa pad+ma rgyal po/ ma bla na med pa pad+ma zab pa'i rgyud gsungs pa las/ 'di ni pad+ma zab pa'i rgyud la brten nas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyi gzugs slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas sam khye'u pad+ma badz+ra ste/ pad+ma badz+ra chung bar yang grags pa des/ rgyud dbang bskur man ngag dang bcas pa rnams o rgyan gyi rgyal po ma hā pha la dang*/ mkha' 'gro grub pa'i rgyal mo'am bhaṃ ga la'i phag mor grags pa dang*/ za hor gyi yul du dza lan+dha ra pa gsum la gnang ba yin/ de yang rgyal po ma hā pha la de ni tshe rabs mang por spyan ras gzigs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa de la thugs rje chen pos lung bstan te/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang khyod rang 'brel pa yod pas de la dbang bskur sgrub thabs dang bcas pa zhus shig gsungs pa bzhin phyogs thams cad du btsal bas ma rnyed de glang ma'i ri bor khye'u pad+ma badz+ra bya ba zhig yod pa la phyag dang bskor ba mang po byas te rjes su 'dzin par gsol ba btab pas khye'u de spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong du gyur nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur nas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa yin no// de nas grub chen dza lan+dha ra pas/

rigs ngan gyi grong khyer dhū tir bram ze mai tri pa la dbang bskur/ des rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs su rgyal rigs phyag na rdo rje la/ des bal yul rin chen tshul gyi bi ha rar bal po bha dan+ta su ma ti kīrti la/ des bal yul yam bur ras chung rdo rje grags pa la dbang bskur ba yin no// yang ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mos/ ti pu pa dri med bshes gnyen la dbang bskur/ ti pu pas ras chung ba la gnang ba yin zhing*/ bla ma ti pu pas lung bstan pa ltar grub pa'i rgyal mo dngos su mjal te ta la'i lo mar thugs rje chen po'i chos skor rnams mkha' 'gro'i brda yig tu bris pa gnang*/ ras chung pas thugs rje chen po zhal gzigs shing*/ phyis rgya dpe de glan chung lo tsā bas bod skad du bsgyur ba da lta ba mkhal mar grags pa 'di ka'o// de dag ni bka' ma'i dbang du byas pa yin zhing*/ gter ma'i dbang du byas na/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs rje chen po dang*/ gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro dang*/ dpal rta mgrin gsum sprul te de gsum char gyis/ slob dpon chen po la/ khyod ni spyir gdul bya gdug pa can mtha' dag dang*/ khyad par gangs ljongs kyi mi dang mi ma yin kun 'dul bar snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul pa yin pas nged cag gis byin gyis brlab pa dang grogs bya yi gsungs nas dbang bskur/ rgyud dang sgrub thabs bcas gnang ba yin/ des chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan dang mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis la gnang bas lho brag gnam skas can dang*/ sha 'ug stag sgo lho brag khon mthing gi lha khang sogs su gter kha du mar sbas pa las mnga' bdag nyang ral pas lho brag khon mthing gi gter kha bton/ nyang gi sras mi bskyod rdo rjes ras chung pa la gnang ba yin no// ras chung pas bka' gter chu bo gnyis 'dus kyi gdams pa rnams lo ro tshe rkang gi dgon par mgo ston dbang phyug rdo rje'am zangs ri ras pa la gnang*/

des yar lung sog khar gru gu ras chen la/ des spom brag pa chen po la/ des grub chen karma pa chen po la gnang bas thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal nam mkha' khyab pa zhig zhal gzigs/ shar phyogs spungs rir snang ba mtha' yas dang rgyal ba rgya mtsho bgrang las 'das pa zhal gzigs nas gtso bos sgrub thabs bshad/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyis yi ge drug pa dzapra dbyangs su bzlas lung gnang*/ de phyir yig drug gi dzapra dbyangs khrom du mdzad pa yin/ de sogs dag snang gi lo rgyus dpag tu med pa bzhugs shing*/ grub thob karma pak+shi'i man ngag skor gsum du rdo rje snying po'i gzhung dang*/ sgrom chen po brgyad dang*/ gzhung 'jigs byed chen po sogs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i chos skor rnams zab rgyas su bzhugs shing*/ 'di dag ni ming yongs su grags pa karma pa dang 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho gnyis kyi bar na brgyud pa gzhan yod kyang rung med kyang rung zhes gsungs pa ltar bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang dbyer med pa'i grub chen karma pak+shis spungs ri'i dgon par gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum la gnang*/ des karma pa rang byung rdo rje la gnang*/ de nas rim bzhin mkhas btsun rin chen rgyal mtshan/ maṅga la ke tu/ rje btsun rat+na bha dra/ kun mkhyen mthong ba don ldan/ go shrī dpal 'byor don grub nas karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i bar du rim par brgyud cing*/ chos rgyal rat+na gling pas lho brag gnam skas can nas thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor rnams gter nas spyan drangs te rje bdun pa la phul zhing chos kyi bdag por lung gis bstan pas lha sngags de dag gi byin rlabs kyi bka' yang don gyis 'dir 'dus/ des rje btsun mnyan pa grub chen la gnang*/ de nas 'jigs bral mi bskyod rdo rje dang*/ zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag /rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje/

gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug /grub thob karma chags med/ khyab bdag ak+ṣo bh+ya'i mtshan can/ rig 'dzin karma don grub snying po/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub/ 'jam mgon chos kyi 'byung gnas/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rgyal dbang bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bar du brgyud cing*/ de nyid kyi drung nas legs par thos pas shin tu zab cing byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams pa'i smin byed zhu bar byed pa la/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa'i bdag bdun bum pa sgrub pa bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang bcas pa grub pas khyed rang slob ma rnams kyis bgyi bar 'os pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul/ zhes maṇ+ḍal phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sngon du song nas dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug pa la sngon du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag ni 'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba skyes// 'jig rten bya ba thams cad spangs nas ni// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog dam pa 'dir// mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas slar yang gsang sngags kyi zag med bde ba chen po 'dod pa'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// gtso bor lha mor bcas pa yi// lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor du gsol ba btab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi sgo nang du gnas pas/ lha tshogs rnams kyi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal bar dmigs la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas pas phyag mdzod cig /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas/

na maḥte hūm̐ mgrin par/ na maḥmi hūm̐ snying gar/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ sgo de nyid nas thon te dkyil 'khor gyi phyir g.yas bskor gyis song nas/ lho'i sgo nang du gnas pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag mdzod cig /sogs gong ltar/ slar sgo de nyid nas thon te/ nub kyi sgo nang du gnas pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag mdzod cig /oṃ ma ṇi sogs/ slar sgo de nyid nas thon te byang gi sgo dang du gnas pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag mdzod cig /oṃ ma ṇi sogs/ slar shar gyi sgo nang du gnas pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i drung du sngags kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams blangs nas bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims rnams// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*/ rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// zang zing chos dang mi 'jigs byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu byin// byang chub chen po las byung ba// pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog bsdus pa la// sdom pa thams cad yang dag ldan// kun nas so sor gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral par bgyi// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// 'gro kun mya ngan 'das la 'god// zhes lan gsum/

de nas khyed rang rnams skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon 'og mas me tog pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa/ rnam bkra lha'i dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par sgoms shig /rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo dri'i chu dang bcas pas spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying gar reg cing*/ de nas gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ de nas sngags kyi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa'i phyir yi dam lha'i thugs kar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang pa'i steng du/ don dam pa byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa re bsgom la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+taṃ ut+pa da yā mi/ zhes lan gsum/ de ltar sems bskyed pa de nyid brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag /su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ de nas dam tshig bsgrag pa las/ dang po dkyil 'khor lha'i dam tshig ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag /khyod ni rnal 'byor rigs su skyes// nga yis ye shes rdo rje sbyin// byin pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur// gang gis 'di 'dra ma mthong ba'i// drung du smra bar ma byed cig /bag med smras na nyams par 'gyur// de bas nga rgyal bcom nas ni// bdag nyid ma 'khrul shes par gyis// de ltar dam tshig bsgrags nas tsan+dan dang gur gum la sogs pas bgos pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i dam chu sbyin pa ni/

bdud rtsi lnga'i chu blud cing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ sarba pañca amṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha hūm̐/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' gnyan pa'i dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag /deng 'di nas ni bu khyod kyi// rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi// nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa// khyod kyis skyo ba med par sgrubs// gang yang nga la ma gus min// de bzhin gus par ma byas na// bdud kyis bcom nas ngan 'gror 'gro// de bas dam tshig gnas par gyis// de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o// de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du man+ḍal/ man+ḍal phul nas/ da khyed rang rnams langs la spyi bor chos 'byung gi phyag rgya byas nas/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ khyed rnams bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug tu bsgom pa'i lus kyi nang stong zhing gsal ba'i lte bar pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng du g.yung drung dmar po g.yon du 'khyil ba re/ de'i steng du hrīḥlas sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la phog cing*/ 'od zer tshur 'dus nas lte ba'i hrīḥl thim pas lus sems thams cad bde ba chen pos khyab par bsgom la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig /jo bo thugs rje chen po bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ slob dpon pad+ma grub thob brgyud pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dpal rta mgrin dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

dam can chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gsum/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa char bab pa ltar byon nas/ khyod rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pa'i mos pa rtse gcig tu mdzod/ gu gul gyis bdug /rol mo dang bcas pas/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ maṇi pad+me hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra wā rā hi/ bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+kha nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsā nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya hūm̐ dzaḥ ā be sha ya/ ā be sha ya/ aḥ.aḥ zhes ye shes pa ma phebs kyi bar du brjod/ de ltar phab ba'i ye shes pa de nyid ngo sprad pa'i phyir rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// sems nyid cir yang grub pa med/ grub pa med pa'i sems nyid la// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// snang tsam nyid nas sems su 'dus// sems can kun gyi sems nyid de// bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin// rnam par mi rtog bsam mi khyab// gsal ba de'i ngo bor snang*// mos pa du ma'i sems can la// thabs rnams sna tshogs ston pa ste// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i sbyor ba yi// dpa' bo seṅge bzhin du spyod// bsam gyis mi khyab go 'phang thob// spyan ras gzigs kyi byin rlabs yin// bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni// sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin du// skal ldan rnams kyi spyod yul yin// spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ de ltar dbab pa'i ye shes pa de nyid brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ces brjod/ mig ras kyi 'og nas dkyil 'khor gyi bar snang la ltos la kha dog ji ltar mthong ba smros shig /kha dog ci mthong brjod bcug /de ltar dkar po la zhi ba/ ser po la rgyas pa/ dmar po la dbang*/ ljang gu'am nag po la drag po/ kha dog sna tshogs la las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur ro// ces brjod/

de nas dkyil 'khor gyi drung du me tog dor ba'i phyir slob dpon gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyi tshig brjod pa ni/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha rnams kyi ni rigs ji bzhin// ji ltar bsod nams de bzhin shog /me tog gi phreng ba 'di khyod kyi skye ba snga ma la las kyi 'phro yod pa'i lha gang yin pa la phog par gyur cig ces yid la gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos/ bde gshegs snying bo'i dkyil 'khor du// rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas// sngon tshe gang la sbyangs pa'i lha// gang yin de la phog par shog /pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod bzhin pas me tog dkyil 'khor la 'dor zhig /zhes brjod la dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dor du bcug /slob dpon gyis lha gang la phog pa brtag la me tog blangs nas/ me tog gang la phog pa'i lha de nyid spyi bor thim par sgoms shig /sems dpa' stobs chen khyod kyis ni// 'di ni rab tu gzung bar gyis// pra ti gṛh+na i maṃ ba la ma hā sa twa/ khyod gtso bo 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rigs yin pas dpal dgyes pa'i pad+ma zhes bya'o// gzhan rigs lnga gang la babs pa'i gsang mtshan so sor btag go// zhes me tog spyi bor bzhag /de nas gdong g.yogs bsal ba ni/ gser gyi thur mas ma rig pa'i ling thog dang mig dar lhan cig tu bsal pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spyan ras gzigs dbang deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ya swā hā/ zhes mig dar bsal/ de nas dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che// dkyil 'khor snying po 'di la ltos// zhes dkyil 'khor la lta bar bskul nas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lha rnams ngo sprad par bya ste/ de'ang sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams pad+ma rā ga las grub pa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar byang chub shing gi steng du pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyi dbus su gzhal yas khang yangs shing rgya che ba gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi ldan/

ka ba brgyad kyis mdzes pa/ dbus su zlum skor gtso bo'i 'dom gang ba/ de'i mthar rgya gram dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ 'khor lo'i gdung zlum po/ de'i mthar rgya gram gyi gdung gi sna bzhi phyir lhag pa la rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa/ phyi'i dbyibs gtso bo'i 'dom brgyad dang ldan pa/ ye shes lnga yi rang mdangs ldan pa'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang*/ rin po che'i pha gu'i steng du mun snam la rin po che'i drwa bas mdzes pa/ de'i steng du gdung gi snar rgya gram gyis mtshan cing phyir la 'dom phyed lhag pa 'dod snam dang mnyam pa'i steng du mda' yab kyis brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i tog gi rdo rje rgya gram gyi steng du chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa bcu gsum dang*/ rta babs re re'i steng du chos 'khor rim pa bcu pa/ de rnams gdugs char khebs dar dpyangs tog gis spras pa/ phyogs bzhir ri dwags bzhi bzhi/ mtshams bzhi na ba dan bzhi bzhi/ rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod snam gyis 'khor ba'i zur bcu gnyis la ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i rwa gur me ri dang bcas pa'o// dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud cing thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og mas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ g.yon 'og mas pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing 'od dang 'od zer 'bar ba/ phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dang rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang pos yum la 'khyud cing thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og mas mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba dang*/ g.yon gyi 'og mas pad+ma bsnams pa/

yum bzhi sku mdog sngo ser dmar ljang phyag bzhi'i dang po yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas kyi 'og ma rnams 'khor lo dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang ut+pal 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma rnams pad+ma bsnams pa/ mtshams bzhir rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma sngo ser dmar ljang g.yas rnams kyi rdo rje nor bu bum pa ral gri/ g.yon rnams pad+ma bsnams pa/ sku la rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyi rol du 'dod snam la 'khod pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i rdo rje lha mo rnams dang bcas pa gsal bar bzhugs pa de dag kyang don dam par rang sems bde gshegs snying po'i rang mdangs ye shes kyi rol pa mtshan 'dzin yid byed dang bral ba chos dbyings bsam mi khyab pa'i ngang tshul du bzhugs pa glo bur gyi dri ma'i sbyang bya mtha' dag gsang sngags kyi thabs zab mos skad cig ma 'dir byang nas mtshon byed dpe'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i mtshon bya don gyi dkyil 'khor yang sgrib med mngon sum du mthong pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas de la spro ba bskyed nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor rigs su skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlobs// 'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kun// thams cad 'di las 'byung bas na// dam tshig thams cad spyod pa dang*// dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyongs// gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis// ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bris ba 'di dpe yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i gzhal med khang pa na rigs lnga'i spyan ras gzigs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'di lta bur bsgoms pa la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa yin pas/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la brtson par gyis shig /ces lha ngo bstan/ de rnams kyis 'jug pa'i chos rnams song ba yin/ dngos bzhi'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/

zhes maṇ+ḍal phul la/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha dad med pa'i drung du dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhu ba las bum dbang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// mgon po gzi brjid 'od dpag med// rgyal sras tshogs dang bcas pa la// dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa ltar// de bzhin bla ma khyed kyis kyang*// bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon 'og mas me tog pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa/ rnam bkra lha'i dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur pa la/ bum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i don du mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rin po che'i bum pa thogs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod cig /bum pa spyi bor bzhag /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// sangs rgyas rnams kyis bum pa'i dbang*// rgyal sras rnams la bskur ba ltar// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// chos dbyings ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis longs// sku mchog bum pa'i dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog /yi ge bcu pa dang*/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ bum chus bkru zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hūm̐/ de ltar rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo bum pa'i dbang bskur pas nyon mongs pa ga

ti mug dag /gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes thob par sgoms shig /de nas rdo rje'i dbang bskur pa'i don du mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams kyis rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ rdo rje 'di dang tha dad med par/ thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i lha tshogs dpag tu med par byon nas/ khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /rdo rje g.yas su byin la/ mi bskyod rgyal po rigs kyi gtso// zhe sdang rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// me long ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis longs// thugs mchog rdo rje'i dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog /yi ge bcu pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ de ltar mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dag /rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes thob bar sgoms shig /de nas gsung mchog glegs bam gyi dbang bskur ba'i don du mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams kyis glegs bam gyi dbang bskur bas glegs bam 'di dang tha dad med par snang ba mtha' yas kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byon nas khyed rang rnams la thim pas gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /yi ge drug pa'i glegs bam lag tu gtad la/ pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// 'dod chags rnam par dag pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung mchog dbang*// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// sor rtog ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis longs// gsung mchog glegs bam dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog /yi ge bcu pa dang*/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ de ltar 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo glegs bam gyi dbang bskur bas/

nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag /'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes thob par sgoms shig /de nas dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur ba'i don du mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes gyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams kyis dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas/ dbu rgyan 'di dang tha dad med par rin chen 'byung ldan gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byon nas khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ rang byung ye shes kyi dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /dbu rgyan dang cod pan rin po che'i phreng ba mgo bor bcings la/ rin chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// nga rgyal rnam par dag pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// mnyam nyid ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis longs// yon tan dbu rgyan dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog /yi ge bcu pa dang*/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca trām̐/ de ltar rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dag /tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes thob par sgoms shig /de nas dril bu'i dbang bskur ba'i don du mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams kyis dril bu'i dbang bskur bas/ dril bu 'di dang tha dad med par don yod grub pa'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byon nas khyed rang rnams la thim pas phrin las rnam bzhi'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /ces dril bu lag g.yon du byin la/ phrin las yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du// phrag dog rang sar dag pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams kyi phrin las dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// bya grub ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis longs// phrin las dril bu'i dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog

/yi ge bcu pa dang*/ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñca āḥ de ltar don yod grub ba'i ngo bo dril bu'i dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog dag /'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes thob par sgoms shig /de nas ming gi dbang bskur ba'i don du mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams kyis rdo rje'i ming gi dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje dril bu mgo thog tu bzhag /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ming gi dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas nyid du rab bsgrub phyir// ming gi dbang mchog chen po byin// kye dpal dgyes pa'i pad+ma zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis rigs drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo rdo rje'i brtul zhugs byin par mos shig /rdo rje lag tu gtad la/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ e ṣa dha ra yā mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ de ltar rdul ras bris mchan tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas lus la bum pa'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa lnga dag /phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga'i spyan ras gzigs bsgom pa la dbang ba yin no// gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ gsang dbang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// mgon po gzi brjid 'od dpag med// rgyal sras tshogs dang bcas pa la// dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa ltar// de bzhin bla ma khyed kyis kyang*// bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum/ sngon du rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du bzhag pa'i ka pā la'i bdud rtsi dang byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar sbyar ba mgrin par gtugs la/

slob dpon bdag nyid kyi phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i spyan ras gzigs dang*/ yum bzhi/ sems dpa' brgyad sogs su rnam par dag pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ yum gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma yab yum gnyis su med par sbyor ba las/ bdud rtsi byang sems kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thod pa'i dbang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab bsgrubs pa// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// gsang mchog thod pa'i dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya hūm̐ dzaḥ.a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi slob ma'i lce la bzhag la/ de ltar rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas ngag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas ngag gi sgrib pa dag nas/ rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa bsgom pa la dbang ba yin no// shes rab dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// mgon po gzi brjid 'od dpag med// rgyal sras tshogs dang bcas pa la// dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa ltar// de bzhin bla ma khyed kyis kyang*// bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas mu tig dmar po'i phreng pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon 'og mas me tog pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa/ rnam bkra lha'i dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/

zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur pa la/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis yum gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gnyis phyag gnyis ma/ phag zhal dmar po spyi btsugs tu phyung ba/ rtsa ba'i khro zhal spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba la thod pa skam po lngas brgyan cing*/ thod ba rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ rus ba'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod khrag 'dzin par gyur pa'i rig ma sbyin pa ni/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags// 'khor lo rim pa'i sbyor ba yis// bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis// zhes slob ma la byin pa na des kyang gur gum la sogs pas dri zhim par byas shing*/ lus gos dang bral ba'i chu skyes slob ma la mngon sum du byas nas/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan// gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa// de yi mdun na bdag gnas so// sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa// pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ bhañca mo k+ṣa hoḥ de nas yab yum lha'i gzugs kyis rdo rje dang pad+ma/ hūm̐ dang a las skyes pa'i nor bu dang*/ ze'u 'bru dag oṃ dang a las byung ba/ rdo rje'i khar phaṭa ser pos mtshan par gyur pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi shes rab dbang*// sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsgrubs pa// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// shes rab ye shes dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ dhu ma gha ye na maḥswā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya hūm̐ dzaḥ.a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes brjod la sin dhū ra snying gar byugs/ gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang gnyis su med pa las dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos shig /de ltar chos kyi 'byung gnas sin dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas sems la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/

sems kyi sgrib pa dag nas/ byang chub sems kyi gdams ngag bsgom pa la dbang ba yin no// de nas bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che snang srid phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor lam mngon du byed pa'i phyir de nyid kyi slad du maṇ+ḍal/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bzhi pa'i dbang gi don du gsol ba 'debs ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// mgon po gzi brjid 'od dpag med// rgyal sras tshogs dang bcas pa la// dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa ltar// de bzhin bla ma khyed kyis kyang*// bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ 'dir dbang bzhi pa'i don du bla ma'i tshig gis brda sprad par bya ste/ me long yongs su dag pa la shar ba'i rdo rje 'chang gi gzugs brnyan ni gang las kyang ma skyes/ gnas pa'i tshe me long gi mdun rgyab bam/ rdul phra rab dang 'dres par yang mi gnas/ mi snang bar gyur pa'i tshe gang du'ang bzhud pa mi dmigs la/ mi dmigs bzhin du rdo rje 'chang gi gzugs brnyan gsal bar snang ba ltar/ rang gi lus yi dam gyi lha'i sku stong bzhin du nye bar snang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dpe'i khyad par du ma can shin tu 'od gsal ba la/ de nyid kyi tshe yang snang ba nyid rang bzhin med pa'o// de bzhin du brag cha 'byung ba'i phyogs su gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis sogs tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ sngags kyi sgra dang bstod pa dang*/ skur 'debs sogs brjod pa na/ brag ca las kyang de nyid gsal bar brjod pa 'byung ba na/ rang bzhin mi dmigs pa ltar rang gis brjod pa'i sgra grag pa nyid kyi tshe na'ang rang bzhin med par stong bzhin du ā li kā li sogs stong pa nyid kyi rang sgra 'byung ba ste med snang ro mnyam pa'o// de bzhin du smig rgyu chu med pa la ri dwags rnams kyis chur 'du shes nas bsnyegs mod kyi/ de la nam yang chu mi rnyed de nyam nyes par 'gyur la/

smig rgyur shes pa na de la brten pa'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ nyam nyes pa mi 'byung ba ltar/ sems rnam par g.yo ba'i rgyun smig rgyu ltar nye bar snang ba la byis pa rnams kyi ngor bde sdug 'khor 'das sogs nye bar dmigs te spang blang sogs mtshan ma la spyod pas ngal ba thob par 'gyur la/ rang gi sems smig rgyu ltar snang ba 'di ni nges par rang bzhin med pa ste/ 'khrul grol gyi mtshan ma rnams rnam pa thams cad du ma dmigs pa/ yin min yod med sogs mtha' dang bral ba mnyam pa nyid chen po'i dbyings/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ye shes gzhom du med pa nyid du blta bar bya'o// de ltar snang srid phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas sgo gsum la bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bas sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi sgrib pa dag nas lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang ba yin no// dbang 'di rnams kyi don yang*/ pad+ma zab pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa/ bum pa'i dbang ni dang po ste// gsang ba'i dbang ni gnyis pa'o// shes rab ye shes gsum pa ste// nges shes bskyed pa bzhi pa yin// lha dang sngags dang stong pa nyid// bde stong 'dres par sgom pa dbang*// tha mal lus kyi rnam rtog ni// dang po bum pa'i dbang gis bcad// rang bzhin lha yi rnam pa bsgom// tha mal ngag gi rnam rtog ni// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang gis bcad// bzlas brjod rgyun du bzlas pa'o// tha mal sems kyi rnam rtog ni// gsum pa shes rab dbang gis bcad// bde dang stong pa'i don dran bya// 'bras bu thams cad bsdus pa ni// bzhi pa ye shes dbang yin no// zhes gsungs pa yin no// de nas rdo rje slob dpon dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang gis bdag ni khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don nus 'gyur ba// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// thugs rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol// lan gsum/

slob dpon gyis rdo rje lag tu blangs te/ rdo rje stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs su gyur/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das mchog gi dang po'i skyes bu'o// zhes slob ma'i lag pa g.yas su gtad/ de ni rdo rje'i dam tshig go// dril bu stong pa'i ngang las/ āḥ las skyes pa'i dril bu/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung*// g.yon du gtad/ de nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis bdag /ngo bo nyid dang 'gal srid byas// rang bzhin dag mchog sems dpa' yis// dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur// zhes brjod cing dkrol/ de ni dril bu'i dam tshig go// khyed rang bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba dang*/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya kha sbyor gyi rim pas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis/ yid kyi lus brtan brtul zhugs ni// phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod// gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan// des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags// zhes brjod/ de ni phyag rgya'i dam tshig go// slob ma bdag nyid kyi zhal du zhugs shing*/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de lha mo'i pad+ma gnas pa/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ dang rdo rje las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' ye shes sems dpa' dang dbyer med pa la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang*/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams la rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod bar bya ba/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ/ dhū pe sogs/

rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de ltar 'di la bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pa las de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab dang snyoms par zhugs pas/ de rnams 'dod chags chen pos zhu bar gyur nas rnam snang gi sgo nas nang du zhugs te/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba'i khu bas dbang bskur nas/ slar pad+ma nas phyung ste gral du gnas pa la/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma dang bcas pas bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba phyag gis cung zad yo bar 'dzin pas/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang bcas pas dbang bskur bzhin pa dang*/ rnam rgyal gyi bum pa'i chu mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis dbang bskur bar gyur pa ni/ bum pa kha rgyan rdo rje dang bcas pa slob ma'i spyi bor reg la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pa// rdo rje gsang ba gsum byung ba// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dbang bskur bas/ bde ba chen po phun sum tshogs par gyur pa'i spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan rnams dang lha mo rnams ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bor bcug par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ de ltar rgyud yongs su smin par gyur pa la mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtshos mchod par mos mdzod/ me tog la sogs pa mdun du bshams nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod la/ de'ang 'di lta bu go bar bya ste/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod// de las gzhal yas kyi khang pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin no zhes bya ba sogs dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid rnam par dag pa dang*/

mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu bsgrags// skye mched khams dang dbang po ni// byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /ces sogs lha rnams kyi de kho nyid rnam par dag pa dang*/ don dam par ni dkyil 'khor la sogs pa rnams kyang rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid de bzhin nyid kho na'i de kho na nyid rnam par dag pa dang*/ de nyid bcu la sogs pa'i slob dpon gyi las kyi rim pa ji snyed pa dag dang*/ 'da' bar bya ba ma yin pa'i ngo bo dam tshig dang*/ bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sdom pa rnams shes pas de kho na nyid bzhin du myur du bsgrub par bya zhing*/ gzhan dag kyang gzhug par gyis shig /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du rdo rje dang dril bu byin par mos shig /rdo rje dril bu gtad la/ rdo rje dang ni dril bu longs// rdo rje la ni rab tu gnas// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// de nas rigs lnga'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sgo nas 'gro don rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa ni/ lag tu 'khor lo gtad la/ khyed rang rnams byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// khyod kyis sems can gti mug can rnams kyi don gyis shig /rdo rje lag tu byin la/ sa gnon dang mnyam bzhag byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// rdo rje'i 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// khyod kyis sems can zhe sdang can rnams kyi don gyis shig /rin po che lag tu byin la/

mchog sbyin dang mnyam bzhag byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// nor bu'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor// khyod kyis sems can nga rgyal can rnams kyi don gyis shig /pad+ma lag tu byin la/ mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mtha' yas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor// khyod kyis sems can 'dod chags can rnams kyi don gyis shig /sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu byin la/ skyabs sbyin dang mnyam bzhag byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa don yod grub pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// rgya gram 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// khyod kyi sems can phrag dog can rnams kyi don gyis shig /de nas slar yang sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ spyi bor sin+dhu ra'i thig le byas la/ khyed rnams kyis dus thams cad du bla ma rdo rje'i 'dzin pa spyi bor bsgom pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku'i phrin las bsgrub par gyis shig /de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i don du 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes mchog /dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol// zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags kyis bskor ba las/ sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas zhal nas brgyud de khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs nas snying ga'i hrīḥl thim par mos la sngags zlos shig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad brjod nas/

slob dpon gyis me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag gis sbyin lags kyi// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// de nyid mi 'gyur ba brtan par bya ba'i phyir me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum/ deng phyin chad sngags kyi bzlas pa la brtson pa dang sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung gi phrin las bsgrub par gyis shig /snying gar sin+dhu ra byugs la/ deng nas bzung ste sems can rnams la snying rje chen po bskyed de/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs kyi phrin las bsgrub par gyis shig /slob dpon sprul sku'i cha lugs lag pa g.yon dril bu dang bcas pa chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar 'dzin pa snying gar bzung ba dang*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas/ de nas lung bstan pa dang dbugs dbyung ba ni/ de ring ngas khyod lung bstan te// 'od dpag med pa de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun las grol// kyai dpal dgyes pa'i pad+ma zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhur bhu wa swaḥ ma 'ongs pa na rigs kyi gsang mtshan dang mthun pa'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur te/ gang 'di ltar lung bstan pa de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston pa yin te/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can gdul dka' ba rnams kyi don du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi gzugs su gyur pas bde ba la 'god bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na khyed rnams kyis deng phyin chad bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgo nas 'gro ba'i don rgya chen bsgrub pa dang phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin 'dzin snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// sogs/ de ltar dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa 'bul snyam pas rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ des bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo nas dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu bskur ba yin pas 'di nyid kyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ de nas tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma rjes chog bkra shis sogs bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni dang po'i blo can rnams la phan phyir si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bsgrigs pa'i dge bas lus can mtha' dag 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug gi go 'phang la 'god pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga lam/// /
